title: iCHiBA
tagline: A Marketplace for tokens and exchange in the web3 space using latest from NEXT.js for frontend running on polygon and IPFS storarge.
description: A Marketplace for tokens and exchange in the web3 space. A focus on NFTs and a bit of DeFi along with it. Basically exploring the latest Web3 protocols and to provide utility and exposure to the various flavours of web3. We want to bring in adoption by making fun but useful dapps that can help to bridge the technology gap, and increase the widespread use.
how_its_made: Using a typical fullstack with latest technologies. Solidiy, Typescript/Javascript, Hardhat, Ethers, Tailwindcss, React. Also using Next.JS and surge to display some static data. A great deal of implementation from scaffold-eth, IPFS and and of course this is running on polygon network.
